visible_goal: Analyze a rectangular aluminum block under axial tensile loading; report end displacement and stress.
selection_reason: Linear elastic solid block tension is a low-risk cross-solver replacement task.

metric_definitions.end_displacement: Arithmetic mean final global U1 in mm over every node on the complete undeformed X=120 end face.
metric_definitions.max_stress: Maximum final Mises stress in MPa over the complete native solid result: all stored Abaqus integration-point S values or the complete ANSYS native nodal-extrapolated equivalent-stress field.

bounds_semantics: open intervals used only as broad physical sanity filters; native-result agreement and the task contract determine acceptance
